The infrastructure exists. GitHub Pages or [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-first-principles|Cloudflare R2]] Pages serves the storefront. NOWPayments verifies the payment on-chain and fires a webhook automatically. The product delivers before the buyer closes their wallet. The only question is whether you have assembled the stack correctly.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

Each option provides a unique set of features catering to different needs. CoreMerch's Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offer a complete digital commerce stack with GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages hosting, Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script backend logic, Supabase and Google Sheets order storage, Google Drive and Cloudflare R2 file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, charges a 0.5% fee, and does not require KYC or buyer accounts. In contrast, Binance P2P supports multiple fiat currencies, including naira, cedis, and Kenyan shillings, but lacks the comprehensive digital commerce stack offered by CoreMerch.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

CoreMerch's infrastructure is designed to bypass traditional payment gateways, allowing sellers in restricted countries to operate freely. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all the necessary tools to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, ensuring that sellers can collect payments from international buyers without relying on Stripe or PayPal. In contrast, Binance P2P may not be available in all restricted countries, and its reliance on fiat currencies limits its appeal for international sellers.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments offers fast and secure payment processing, with USDT on Tron settling in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. This makes it an attractive option for sellers who need to process payments quickly and efficiently. In contrast, Binance P2P may charge higher fees for fiat currency transactions, and its reliance on traditional payment gateways may lead to slower payment processing times.

Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

CoreMerch's infrastructure prioritizes ownership, automation, and delivery, allowing sellers to maintain full control over their data and payment processing. In contrast, Binance P2P may require manual intervention for payment processing and delivery, limiting its appeal for sellers who value automation and ownership.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The choice between CoreMerch's infrastructure and Binance P2P depends on the seller's specific needs and circumstances. Sellers who prioritize ownership, automation, and delivery may prefer CoreMerch's Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack. In contrast, sellers who require fiat currency support may prefer Binance P2P. Ultimately, the key is to choose an architecture that aligns with the seller's business goals and values.
